author: Codex
method: Descriptive JEV scores for a fixed historical corpus. Thresholds 50, 80 and 90 were specified in its frozen plan. Topic questions overlap; shares do not sum to 100%. Missing assessments are excluded question by question. Conversation counts are any-candidate and depend on dialogue length. No independent human calibration or causal model comparison is implied. Clean recorded history does not prove missing historical runtime metadata valid.
